description: Stage 1 engineering dependency graph and future reconciliation tasks; NOT a live mirror of the clinical sprint.

snapshot.note: Read the current branch/PR/CI before every reconciliation. This immutable snapshot is historical evidence only; passing CI does not imply clinical approval.

tasks.title: Inspect default branch, CI, and active medication sprint
acceptance: Record exact main and sprint head SHAs
Identify active pull request and existing quality workflow
Record the limits of CI versus clinical sign-off

tasks.title: Verify and adopt Stage 1 graph governance
acceptance: Graph structure and unit tests pass in GitHub Actions
Independent PR review completed
Governance files accepted without modifying medication rules

tasks.title: Reconcile sprint inventory and evidence into task graph
acceptance: Read latest PR #37 head, sprint checklist and CI at reconciliation time
Reconcile canonical medication IDs and ingredient/formulation grouping
Map each claimed completed item to commit and CI evidence, or mark unresolved

tasks.title: Adjudicate clinically distinct ingredient/formulation review groups
acceptance: Capture exact formulation-level denominator, not provisional ingredient-set count
Preserve route, release, combination, renal-function and other clinically relevant distinctions
Record uncovered identities and unresolved clinical questions

tasks.title: Reconcile antithrombotic guidelines and test time-based recommendations
acceptance: Record primary guideline citations and material conflicts
Differentiate procedural bleeding and thrombotic risk; account for renal function where relevant
Test interruption and resumption timing with positive, negative and boundary cases

tasks.title: Validate insulin, diabetes therapies and other high-risk medications
acceptance: Review ingredient and formulation-specific regimens with procedure and diet timing
Include prescriber-directed insulin changes, hypoglycemia and type 1 diabetes safeguards
Verify GLP-1, SGLT2, combination and other high-risk group tests

tasks.title: Complete remaining medication coverage and full regression integration
acceptance: Reconcile reviewed group totals with mapped canonical IDs
Run complete test, typecheck, schema and build checks
Document all unresolved guidance conflicts and release blockers

tasks.title: Obtain independent clinical approval for proposed patient-facing guidance
acceptance: Authorized clinician reviews evidence, exact hold/resume timeframes, and special-population caveats
Record approver identity and approval record outside agent-generated assertions
Keep unapproved or conflicting recommendations fail-closed

tasks.title: Authorize production activation only after clinical and release review
acceptance: Verify clinical approval and release authorization independently
Verify production safety, privacy/security and deployment controls
Preserve the ability to roll back without enabling unapproved clinical rules
